text: Completed EyeLink streaming throughput and bounded-memory certification. The stream pipe now enforces readChunkBytes with chunkN for arbitrary upstream chunks; AscStreamingMemoryEnvelope records the logical source-byte ceiling as maximumLineBytes + maximumReadChunkBytes, while AscWorkflowMemoryEnvelope marks materialized retention as input-proportional. The executable JVM court runs forked with -Xmx256m and records typed rows containing source revision/digest/dirty state, named hardware/OS/JVM, profile/workload, input and emission counts, line/chunk budgets, elapsed time, throughput, sampled peak heap delta, HotSpot all-thread allocated bytes, allocation per input byte, JVM heap cap, thresholds, and derived pass status. Unsupported allocation counters fail explicitly. Coverage includes 250/500/1000/2000 Hz, left/right/binocular, message-rich, a materialized case, 64 MiB hostile overlong lines, and scheduled 2000 Hz binocular 2 h. Named baseline: Apple M3 Max 36 GiB, macOS 14.3 arm64, OpenJDK 25.0.1, source dirty at 44b0145 with working source-set SHA-256 3fb7d041e0faec02c7833a4eb62f70f3fb5e68a3f2a694b041ff2869a68fcf21. The 2 h case processed 489,600,081 bytes / 14,400,004 lines in 25.30 s (19,352,880 B/s), sampled peak delta 160,505,360 B, and 101,663,830,032 allocated B (207.646 B/input B); all counts exact and all 7 scheduled rows pass stored 1 MiB/s, 256 MiB heap, and 512 B/input allocation gross thresholds. The 64 MiB hostile case emitted exactly 64 bounded rejections. Cancellation/resource court repeats readPath cancellation 256 times and guards FD growth. Generated checks.yml runs the smoke profile on PRs; generated performance.yml runs weekly/manual scheduled profile with git-archive digest and uploads TSV. No hosted run is claimed yet. Mutation proof: removing rechunking failed the dedicated budget assertion on both JVM and Scala.js; removing allocation from pass status failed the targeted result assertion; both restored. Final gates: header/format/workflow checks green; ioJVM 166/166, ioJS 145/145; packageBin and checkBoundaries green; git diff --check green. Packaged resource META-INF/eyes4s/eyelink/performance-baseline.tsv SHA-256 49dec7ed88008eb106507829911474cf95a52a825b1d0bbb31259db09aa5cac9 exactly matches the checked-in artifact; JAR also contains parity and mutation artifacts.
